comments.body:
Thanks for this, the robots.txt redirect was a real bug. I narrowed it a bit before releasing: `txt` and `xml` as extensions would also skip localized routes like `app/[lng]/sitemap.ts` or `app/[lng]/rss.xml/route.ts`, and with `hideDefaultLocale` or `'internal'` mode those need the rewrite. So the proxy now skips `/robots.txt` as an exact path, plus `avif` and `webmanifest`, and the README and example matchers leave out `robots.txt`, `sitemap.xml` and `manifest.webmanifest`, like the Next.js docs do.

Included in v16.5.1.
